description:
As a performance engineer
  I want key navigation timings measured on real pages
  So that regressions in server response time or page load are caught early

elements.name: Main page meets its navigation timing budget

steps.name: I am on the Wikipedia main page
TTFB should be under 1500 ms
DOMContentLoaded should be under 4000 ms
full page load should be under 6000 ms

name: Navigation timing budgets

description:
As a performance engineer
  I want per-resource load times grouped by type
  So that I can catch one slow CSS/JS/image/API request, not just a slow page overall

elements.name: Main page static assets stay within budget

steps.name: I am on the Wikipedia main page
no stylesheet request should take longer than 3000 ms
no script request should take longer than 3000 ms
no image request should take longer than 3000 ms

name: Resource timing breakdown

description:
As a performance engineer
  I want full network activity captured to a HAR file
  So that I can inspect exact requests and responses outside the test run

elements.name: Visiting the main page produces a non-empty HAR recording

steps.name: I record network activity to a HAR file
I stop recording and close the HAR file
the HAR file should contain at least 1 request
the HAR file's slowest request should be under 10000 ms

name: Network activity recording
